description: The bar chart illustrates the task count for different language groups, comparing the performance of two models, mBERT and XLM-R, against a baseline labeled 'same'. The horizontal axis lists the language groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the task count, ranging from 0 to 40. The bars are color-coded: blue for mBERT, green for XLM-R, and grey for 'same'. The IE-Romance group shows the highest task count for mBERT, while XLM-R performs best in the IE-Slavic group. The 'same' category has the lowest task count across all language groups. The chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
